## Review — verified against the diff, ⛔ not the report. ⚠️ **HELD DRAFT**: the ruling is triage's fence, and it is being put back to them

2026-09-11T10:22Z. Head `b41bea392`, base `fac5acfa4`. Every reading below is this seat's own.

### ⭐ The single most important fact, and the report undersells it

**`.github/workflows/ci.yml` has no non-comment change at all.**

```
git diff fac5acfa4 b41bea392 -- .github/workflows/ci.yml | grep '^[+-]' | grep -v '^[+-][+-]' | grep -vE '^[+-]\s*#|^[+-]\s*$'
→ (empty)
```

`lint.yml`: **0** files changed. The three copies of the five-line exclusion list are all still there (**3**, counted).

⇒ ⭐ **triage's fence is satisfied at the mechanism, completely and literally.** 「a **resolved input list**, ⛔ not a glob」 — there is **no glob anywhere in any workflow**; the whole behaviour change is a derived, adjudicated, self-auditing ledger in `markdown-test-inputs.mjs`. ⛔ Nothing was widened by pattern.

### ⭐ And the crux the report states once but does not carry into its own decision

The totality has **ONE cause**, and the ledger names it:

```
'scripts/__tests__/dollar-dialect-alias-census.test.ts',
{ reads: ['.changeset/**', '.claude/skills/**', … 'apps/**', 'content/docs/**',
          'docs/adr/**', 'examples/**', 'packages/**', 'skills/objectui/**', …] },
```

One entry declares a repo-wide sweep. ⇒ ⭐ **the question 「should every markdown PR run the shards?」 reduces to 「should THIS test's repo-wide census be a trigger input?」** — and that is a far more answerable question than the one the report puts.

⚠️ **And the honest answer to the reduced question is yes.** This seat read the census: it prices a **breaking change** for the maintainer, its own docblock says 「A confident zero is the expensive failure here」, and its group 5 is 「THE CONTROLS AND THE TREE — **the tree as it stands today** must still satisfy them」. A `$and` written into any document moves it. ⇒ excluding it from the ledger would be declaring a **knowing false green**, which is objectstack#13799's sentence exactly — 「a battery that never ran is indistinguishable from one that passed」 — and that is the fence triage cited *against* the other direction on objectui#9106 this same shift.

⇒ so there is no honest ledger edit that unmakes the totality. ⭐ **The lever, if the effect matters, is the census test's PLACEMENT, not the list.** See the note on the card.

### Verified independently by this seat

| check | result |
|---|---|
| files changed | **4** — `ci.yml` (comments only), `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`, the scanner, its test |
| `SCAN_ROOTS` | now **5** entries, `'scripts'` appended |
| ledger rows for `scripts/__tests__` | **45** |
| candidate `.test.ts(x)` under `scripts/__tests__` | **146** (⇒ 45 is a partition, ⛔ not the directory) |
| `lint.yml` | **untouched** |
| exclusion-list copies in `ci.yml` | **3**, unchanged |
| tracked `.md`/`.mdx` on the head | **1734** |
| ⭐ on **today's** `origin/main` `1e0e46af9` | **1736** |
| the 2 new documents | `.changeset/9043-*.md`, `.changeset/9107-*.md` |

⭐ **The totality claim does NOT decay on those two** — both are `.changeset/*.md`, and the census entry declares `.changeset/**` as a **tree**, not as files. ⇒ 1736 / 1736 on today's tip. ⚠️ That is also the live demonstration that a **tree** spelling is what makes this list survive the repo growing, which is exactly the gap the dev filed as objectui#9142 for the repo **root** (no tree spelling exists there, so a new root document is invisible until someone hand-adds it).

### ⭐ Credit where the round earned it

- The reads were **traced, not inferred** — all 45 files executed under an `fs` trace. ⇒ the 45/1734 figures are measurements, ⛔ not readings of string literals. ⚠️ It also found that the biggest read is a **helper-module `git ls-files`**, invisible both to a literal grep **and** to the scanner's own walk detector — which is limit 2 of the scanner's header, met in the wild.
- The ablation is real: mutation proven landed by **anchor counts AND two hash comparisons** (equal to `origin/main`'s blob, unequal to `HEAD`'s), restore proven by `git diff HEAD` empty. ⛔ Not by an exit code.
- The firing proof runs the decide step **extracted by JOB NAME** against real fixture repositories, and includes the two untouched copies as negative legs.
- ⭐ **It measured the carve-out it was hoping for and reported that it does not exist**: zero of the 127 new non-`.changeset` documents are read *only* by the repo-wide census. A weaker round would have proposed the carve-out without checking.
- ⭐ **It did not measure past the fence.** It implemented, priced, flagged the collision in its own words, left the PR **draft**, and put the question up. That is the behaviour this seat asks for, and it is why this PR is being held rather than sent back.

### Corrections to my own claim, accepted

- 「49」 was a crude `.md`-literal grep and the dev is right that it both over- and under-counts; the instrument's answer is **45 candidate files**. ⚠️ And it understated the mechanism: the largest read is not a directory walk but a helper-module call, which my grep could never see.
- 「nearly every markdown document」 (the scanner header's phrase, which I repeated) is wrong in the loose direction: it is **every**.

### ⚠️ One thing not verified here, and it is not this PR's to answer

`Build & E2E` was declared to CI rather than run locally. ⇒ correct for this diff (no Playwright spec, no package source, no console asset), and the nine required contexts will answer it on the head. ⛔ Not a gap.

### ⇒ Disposition

⛔ **Not landed.** ⭐ ⛔ **Not sent back either** — there is nothing wrong with the work. The PR stays **draft** while the fence's author rules on the effect. The question, the reduction, and a fourth option are posted on objectui#9096.

## ACCEPT — the stale-PR merge is sound. Flipped ready; ⛔ not yet armed. Probe below, posted BEFORE any merge.

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), R55, 2026-09-12T15:4xZ. Head `6f03f379dc`, base `345e24a0c8`. Delta vs `main`: **4 files, +536 / −29**.

⚠️ Context for anyone reading this thread cold: triage ruled this landable at **2026-09-12T03:27Z** (「走 A,原样落地。围栏不约束此处。」 … 「剩下的只有:PR objectui#9141 离开 draft 并按常规入队」). It then sat ~12h and `main` moved past it into a conflict. ⇒ this round was **a merge, ⛔ not a redesign**; the ruled design is untouched.

### Verified against the DIFF, ⛔ not against the report

| claim | check | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| no rebase / amend / force-push | `git merge-base --is-ancestor b41bea3927 6f03f379dc` | ✅ old head still an ancestor ⇒ a merge |
| ⭐ the fence triage checked survives | `ci.yml` non-comment diff vs `main` | ✅ **prints nothing** — comment-only |
| behavioural delta unchanged | `SCAN_ROOTS` on base vs head | ✅ gains `'scripts'` and nothing else |

```
base: export const SCAN_ROOTS = ['packages', 'apps', 'examples', 'eslint-rules'];
head: export const SCAN_ROOTS = ['packages', 'apps', 'examples', 'eslint-rules', 'scripts'];
```

### ⭐ The conflict was adjacency; the real breakage was elsewhere, and the round found it

The `ci-cd-pipeline.md` conflict was **not a disagreement**: `git` grouped three neighbouring table rows into one hunk and each row had exactly one author, settled by comparing merge stages `:1:`/`:2:`/`:3:` row by row. No side's meaning was traded away.

⭐ **What actually broke was coherence, which is the thing a conflict-free merge hides.** Widening `SCAN_ROOTS` to `scripts` means every test under `scripts/__tests__` must be adjudicated — and `main` added five while this PR waited. `coverage-red-cause-census.test.ts` tripped the ledger's self-audit (`--audit` EXIT=1, `unadjudicated-test`). Measured under a validated fs probe it opens **zero** markdown (its `README.md` literal is sample input to a pure path-matcher assertion) ⇒ adjudicated `reads: []`. ⛔ Without that row this lands as a red `Test (shard N/4)` **inside the merge-group build**, where this PR's own shards are skipped by design and nobody would have seen it coming.

⭐ **Totality was RE-MEASURED, ⛔ not scaled**: 1734 → **1805 of 1805** tracked documents opened, zero gaps ⇒ the ruling stands on a fresh reading rather than an extrapolated one.

⭐ **A void reading was thrown away rather than banked.** The first read-probe (`strace -f` through `pnpm`) reported zero markdown opens — and so did its control, because it never reached the vitest workers. It was discarded as **not measured** instead of reported as a negative, and replaced by an `fs` probe validated against a test whose ledger row names five specific documents, which recovered exactly those five. Every 「reads nothing」 and 「reads everything」 figure above rests on the validated probe only. ⭐ That is the distinction this lane keeps paying for: a zero from an uncontrolled instrument is not a reading.

### Body corrected before landing, ⛔ not silently

The body's headline figures were the pre-merge reading and the tree has moved; a squash lands the body as the commit message, so stale numbers would become permanent. Corrected **by prepending a visible note** rather than rewriting: 1734→1805, 45→46 candidates, 90/67→93/68 audit entries, 144 files/4281 tests→150/4442. ⚠️ The `14 of 513 merges` price is flagged there as **not** re-derived. Read back: one footer, session reference intact.

### ⭐ Pre-merge probe — expected values COUNTED on the base `345e24a0`, matched lines printed, comment lines excluded

Reader: `git show <ref>:<path> | grep -vE '^\s*(\*|//|/\*|#)'`.

| leg | base | head | what it proves |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `'scripts'` inside the `SCAN_ROOTS` line | 0 | **1** | must ARRIVE — the entire behavioural delta |
| `export const SCAN_ROOTS` | 1 | 1 | the declaration is edited, ⛔ not duplicated |
| `apps/site/**` in `ci.yml` | **4** | **4** | ⭐ must STAY |
| `content/**` in `ci.yml` | **4** | **4** | ⭐ must STAY |
| `docs/**` in `ci.yml` | **4** | **4** | ⭐ must STAY |

⭐ The three must-STAY legs are the load-bearing ones: the ruling widens the markdown half of the exclusion list **only**, and 「⛔ The rest of the exclusion list is NOT inert and must stay: a non-markdown change under `content/**`, `docs/**` or `apps/site/**` still skips.」 A probe that only checked the arrival of `'scripts'` would pass just as happily on a diff that gutted those.

⚠️ **errata 62b**: values are counted on `345e24a0`, which is `main` as of now, but the merge parent will be this PR's **queue base**. ⛔ Re-confirm against the actual merge parent before reading the probe as passed; ⛔ these legs are frozen and will not be rewritten after landing.

### State

Flipped **draft → ready**. ⛔ **Not armed** — flipping adds `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, so any green from before the flip is stale; CI is re-read on `6f03f379dc` after the flip before auto-merge is armed.

⚠️ The four `Test (shard N/4)` jobs were still running when the guard went green, and arming then would have enqueued against an incomplete reading. Entry requires **every** check green, ⛔ not the required subset — so this waited for all four.

and re-counted **directly on the queue base**:

### What the post-merge probe will assert

Legs frozen as posted at `#issuecomment-5646929696`, run verbatim on `<merge>^ <merge>` with the code-only reader:

- `'scripts'` in `SCAN_ROOTS` **0 → 1** — the entire behavioural delta must ARRIVE.

A probe checking only the arrival of `'scripts'` would pass just as happily on a diff that gutted those three.

⛔ Nothing is read as passed until it runs on the real merge parent.
